task: Create a stunning modern Spider-Man website with a dark cinematic theme, featuring a web marquee, interactive suit gallery, and multi-page navigation.

steps.name: navigation_component
steps.prompt: Create a 'Header' component (id: header_main) for the Spider-Man website. It should be a sticky, glassmorphic navbar. Include a 'Spider Logo' (SVG icon), and links to Home, Suits, Villains, and Comics. Add a 'Be a Hero' CTA button with a glow effect using bg-primary. The background should be translucent with bg-background/80 and backdrop-blur-md. File name: header.tsx
steps.input: Spider-Man Navigation Links: Home (/), Suits (/suits), Villains (/villains), Comics (/comics).

steps.name: web_marquee_section
steps.prompt: Create a reusable 'WebMarquee' component (id: marquee_ticker). This component will display scrolling text like 'FRIENDLY NEIGHBORHOOD' and 'GREAT POWER GREAT RESPONSIBILITY' with stylized spider-web icons between them. Use the .web-marquee class defined in global CSS. The text should be large, bold, and outline-style using text-transparent and -webkit-text-stroke. Background should be bg-secondary/20. File name: web_marquee.tsx
steps.input: Texts: SPIDER-MAN | PETER PARKER | MILES MORALES | MULTIVERSE | WEBSLINGER

steps.name: home_hero_section
steps.prompt: Create the 'HomeHero' section (id: home_hero) for the homepage. It should feature a large high-impact heading 'THWIP INTO ACTION', a subheading about the multiverse, and an primary action button. Include a background gradient from-primary/20 to-background. Add a subtle 'floating' animation to an image placeholder where a 3D Spider-Man would sit. Use bg-primary for the main CTA. File name: hero.tsx
steps.input: Headline: 'Unleash Your Inner Hero'. Subtitle: 'Explore the vast horizons of the Spider-Verse and the legacy of the Web-Slinger.'

steps.name: suits_gallery_page
steps.prompt: Create a 'SuitsPage' (id: suits_page) with a grid layout. Each card (id: suit_card) should display a Spidey suit (Classic, Iron Spider, Symbiote, Miles). Use bg-card and border-border. On hover, the card should glow with the suit's signature color (e.g., Red for classic, Black for Symbiote) using shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(...)] and scale up. Each card should have a 'View Details' button. File name: suits.tsx
steps.input: Suits: Classic Red & Blue, Stealth Suit (Big Time), Superior Spider-Man, 2099 White Suit.

steps.name: villains_gallery_page
steps.prompt: Create a 'VillainsPage' (id: villains_page) with a dark, menacing grid. Each card (id: villain_card) should use a more aggressive styling: darker background oklch(0.08 0.02 250) and a hover effect that reveals a 'Spider-Sense' warning icon. Include villains like Green Goblin, Doc Ock, and Venom. Add a 'Danger Level' badge to each. File name: villains.tsx
steps.input: Villains: Green Goblin (High), Doc Ock (Medium), Venom (Extreme), Mysterio (Medium).

steps.name: comics_marquee_section
steps.prompt: Create a 'ComicsPage' (id: comics_page) featuring a list of iconic comic covers in a masonry-style grid. Include a 'WebMarquee' at the top of this page. Use hover:translate-y-[-10px] for the comic cards to give a 'web-pull' feel. Use bg-secondary for the comic card containers. File name: comics.tsx
steps.input: Comics: Amazing Fantasy #15, The Night Gwen Stacy Died, Kraven's Last Hunt, Spider-Verse #1.

steps.name: app_routing_setup
steps.prompt: Create the main 'App.tsx' file. Set up the routing using wouter or react-router-dom. Import the Header and Footer (create a simple footer id: footer_main) and wrap them around the Routes for Home, Suits, Villains, and Comics. Ensure smooth scrolling between transitions. Use the background color bg-background for the main wrapper. File name: App.tsx
